list: the official 55 trophies as shipped (names, descriptions, grades and points quoted verbatim)
sources: Rockstar Games — the official PS5 trophy list shipped with the game (every name, description, grade and point value is quoted verbatim; 55 trophies, 1 Platinum / 2 Gold / 6 Silver / 46 Bronze, 1,350 points).

PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com, Nov 18 2026): ~200 hours, 4/10 difficulty, one playthrough, 0 online and 0 glitched trophies, no mission replay, 15 manual save slots, and one potentially missable trophy (Positive Mental Attitude, the Chapter 1 meditation).
PSNProfiles / Exophase — the live PS5 trophy list (55 trophies, 1,350 points) and community rarity data for strategy tips.
GTABase and Insider Gaming — matching tier and point breakdowns used to double-check every grade.
GTA Forums trophy board — community consensus on the trickier steps (partner co-op trophies, launder timers, gang operations).

roadmap.intro: Roughly 200 hours, all offline, one playthrough (PowerPyx rates it 4/10 difficulty). There are no online trophies and no glitched trophies. The one thing that can cost you a second run is missables: there is no mission replay, so anything tied to a story window is gone once that chapter closes. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter (you get 15 slots) and you cannot lose anything.

phases.title: Play the story — and bank the 5 missables on the way
phases.trophies: Every story trophy (Just Like Paradise through You Gotta Know When to Get Off) plus the five missables: Positive Mental Attitude, Baited My Tackle, Catch Me If You Can, Challenging Tank and Personal Best.
phases.detail: Play chapters in order and take the 15 manual save slots seriously: save at the start of each chapter. Positive Mental Attitude needs the Chapter 1 meditation at Jason's house right after the 'Down to Earth' mission — the only spot that is chapter-locked, so do it the moment it opens. Baited My Tackle (Cal's fishing), Catch Me If You Can (the VCIA airfield) and Challenging Tank (the Rhino window) are all one-window opportunities. Personal Best fires automatically at its story beat. Everything else here is unmissable.

phases.title: Stranger strands & the partner quick wins
phases.trophies: Road to Rehabilitation, This Was No Boat Accident, The Lone Rider, Supply & Demand, Spin On This!, Fair Game, Strangers & Freaks, plus Hot Together, Retail Therapy and Gunslinger.
phases.detail: Clear the six named stranger strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret) to bank Strangers & Freaks too. Hot Together and Retail Therapy need your partner present but are doable anytime in free roam — knock them out back-to-back. Gunslinger just needs one 5-enemy fight; a gang illegal operation is the reliable farm. None of this phase is missable.

phases.title: The grind: collectibles, activities and the economy
phases.trophies: Cunning Stunts, Master of None, The Shootist, Top Fun, Earn Cash Not Kudos, Stick Fiddler, Don't Touch My Deck, You WAiNKer!, One Last Thing, Whip It Good, Sneakthief, Maximum Withdrawal, A Classic Blitz Play, The Goodtime State, Pest Control, In The Beginning…, Capital Offense, Let's Go Bowling, Ten Pin, Bad Luck I Guess, The Truth Is Out There, On the Spot, Dime on the Dollar, Treat Yo Self, Little Boxes and Actions Speak Louder.
phases.detail: The long tail: 250 stunts, 42 gold Shooting Range challenges, 14 Top Fun drone races, 20 race wins, 3 collectible card sets, 100 WAiNK spots, 50 challenges, 100 discovered vehicles, 5 bank vaults, 100% map exploration, all 8 garages, $250k laundered, $100k spent, 10 Scooter Bros registrations and 500 dialogue choices. Buy the garages early — they double as fast-travel spawn points for the collectible sweeps. Actions Speak Louder hits 500 choices naturally before you finish the grind.

phases.title: 100% Completion, then the platinum
phases.trophies: A Long Road, then Vice Got a Price!
phases.detail: Finish whatever the in-game 100% checklist still lists (strangers, activities, collectibles, properties — PowerPyx breaks the checklist down as 200/277 vehicles, 100/255 animals and 70/80 challenges). Once A Long Road pops and the last strays are in, Vice Got a Price! unlocks the platinum.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide:
What to do — earn every other trophy on the list.
Where — all of Leonida, every mode and activity.
When — last, by definition.
It is a pure offline checklist: no online play, no co-op, nothing time-gated at the platinum level. Work the roadmap top to bottom and this unlocks itself the moment the 54th trophy pops. Sources: PowerPyx (platinum at the end of the ~200-hour roadmap) and PSNProfiles (1,350 total points).

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide:
What to do — finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission.
Where — the coast where the game opens.
When — unmissable: it is the first thing the story asks of you.
No side objectives matter, so play it however you like; the trophy pops with the mission-complete banner.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide:
What to do — finish every mission in Chapter 1.
Where — the opening act.
When — automatic at the chapter wrap; you cannot skip past it.
Caution: while Chapter 1 is open, grab the Positive Mental Attitude meditation at Jason's house after 'Down to Earth' — it is the one missable in this act and there is no mission replay to come back for it. Sources: PowerPyx flags this chapter for that reason.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide:
What to do — complete all of Chapter 2's missions.
Where — the second act.
When — pops automatically with the chapter's closing mission.
Keep an eye out for Cal's fishing challenge during this stretch if you want Baited My Tackle banked while he is around.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide:
What to do — clear Chapter 3.
Where — the act that opens up Vice City proper.
When — automatic on finishing the act.
Free roam opens around here, so it is a good checkpoint to start grabbing the open-world quick wins like In The Beginning… and Capital Offense.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide:
What to do — finish Chapter 4's mission chain.
Where — the fourth act.
When — automatic at the act's end.
Nothing missable hides in this chapter; the trophy is awarded for completing its last mission.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide:
What to do — beat the game's final mission.
Where — the story's climax.
When — the credits.
One of only two gold trophies (the other is 100% completion). After this the world stays open, which is where most of the platinum actually gets done.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide:
What to do — finish the mission Breakfast Run.
Where — mid-story.
When — on the mission list; it cannot be skipped.
As with every mission trophy, the pop is automatic on the completion screen — no medals or replay requirements exist for story missions (PowerPyx confirms there are no story gold medals).

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide:
What to do — complete The Cartel Heist, the story's big score.
Where — mid-to-late story.
When — on mission completion.
Approach it however you like; trophy-wise only the outcome counts, not the style.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide:
What to do — finish the mission Child's Play.
Where — the story mission list.
When — automatic on completion.
One of the straight mission-list trophies: a single story run sweeps ids 8–13 without any extra effort.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide:
What to do — complete Headliners.
Where — the story's showcase set-piece chapter.
When — on the mission's completion banner.
No side conditions; just see it through.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide:
What to do — finish VCIA Takedown.
Where — the VCIA airport storyline.
When — automatic on completion.
This is the same chapter that hands you Catch Me If You Can if you grab a plane for an 'unscheduled departure' while you are there — combine the two in one visit.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide:
What to do — complete Operation Savage Glory, the late-game operation.
Where — late story.
When — on completion.
The last of the straight mission trophies before the finale.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide:
What to do — finish every 100%-eligible item on the pause-menu Completion checklist.
Where — the whole map.
When — last phase of the roadmap, after the credits when everything is open.
PowerPyx breaks the checklist down to 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals and 70 of 80 challenges, plus strangers, activities, collectibles and properties. The in-game checklist tells you exactly what is left, so nothing here can be permanently missed. Sources: PowerPyx (100% checklist) and GTABase.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide:
What to do — land 250 stunt jumps.
Where — stunt markers are dotted across Leonida's ramps, canals and construction sites; beach and highway-interchange routes chain cleanly.
When — anytime, post-game is easiest.
A completed unique-jump list plus repeatable ramp chains tops you up if the counter stalls, and bailed landings do not register — land clean. Sources: PowerPyx and PSNProfiles both call this one of the big grinds.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide:
What to do — start each of the 9 activity types once: races, Top Fun, shooting range, fishing, arcade, the sports/meditation set, surfing-style, and the collectible hunts.
Where — activity icons across the map.
When — anytime; a five-minute tour once free roam opens.
You only need to try each one, not win.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide:
What to do — gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges.
Where — shooting ranges in Vice City and upstate.
When — anytime; skill-based, not luck.
Community tips (PSNProfiles): learn each drill's target pattern before shooting for score, favor headshots on pop-ups, and replay a near-miss immediately while the pattern is fresh. Expect a few retries on the time-attack drills.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide:
What to do — win (not just finish) a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations.
Where — Top Fun launch points across Leonida.
When — anytime after the activity unlocks.
Fly a practice lap before racing: the drone handles badly on sharp corners, and cutting checkpoints cleanly beats raw speed. The simple AI makes this easier than it sounds.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide:
What to do — win 20 different races (20 unique events, not 20 repeats of the same one).
Where — street race start markers on the map.
When — anytime.
Street races are forgiving; a decent car plus clean cornering beats the AI field. Cross them off in the pause menu to see which still owe you a win.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.missable_note: Tied to Cal's story window — once his chapter closes there is no mission replay, so reload a chapter save if you skipped it.
trophies.guide:
What to do — beat Cal at a fishing challenge when the story offers it.
Where — wherever Cal's mission strand puts you, on the water.
When — MISSABLE: only offered during Cal's stretch of the story (early-to-mid chapters).
The minigame is a patience check: keep tension in the green band and reel only when the fish stops running. Sources: PowerPyx's roadmap note on one-window trophies and PSNProfiles' Cal strand guide.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide:
What to do — see one arcade cabinet game through to its end.
Where — arcades on Vice City's entertainment strips.
When — anytime; costs pocket change.
Most cabinets are simple score-attack loops; survive to the loop's end or hit the win screen and it pops.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide:
What to do — finish Andy's stranger strand to his last mission.
Where — Andy's starting point, marked once discovered (upstate).
When — anytime in free roam; missions unlock progressively.
None of the stranger strands are time-locked, so one skipped during the story is recoverable post-game.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide:
What to do — complete Kenton's stranger strand to its final mission.
Where — Kenton operates on the coast.
When — anytime.
Follow the strand start to finish; the trophy fires only on the strand-closing mission.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide:
What to do — complete Billy's stranger strand final mission.
Where — Billy's patch is out on the country roads.
When — anytime in free roam.
Long rides between checkpoints — bring a fast bike and save between missions.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide:
What to do — complete 8 stranger strands in total.
Where — question-mark strangers across the state.
When — anytime.
There are more than 8 strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret and others), so this stacks naturally with the strand trophies: the five named character strands plus any three others. Check the pause menu's stranger list if the counter stalls.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide:
What to do — finish Randy's stranger strand, final mission included.
Where — Randy's strand starts in the semi-rural ring around Vice City.
When — anytime.
Another strand trophy; it counts toward Strangers & Freaks too.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide:
What to do — complete Tyrone's strand through his last mission.
Where — Tyrone operates in the city.
When — anytime.
Do the strand start-to-finish; the trophy is for the finale, not any individual mission.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missable_note: PowerPyx's one confirmed missable: the Chapter 1 meditation at Jason's house (with Lucia, right after the 'Down to Earth' mission) is the only chapter-locked spot — do it before Chapter 1 ends.
trophies.guide:
What to do — sit and complete the meditation minigame at all 18 spots.
Where — scenic points: beaches, lookouts, the glades, and one at Jason's house.
When — MISSABLE in part: 17 of the 18 spots persist forever, but the Jason's-house spot is only reachable during Chapter 1, right after 'Down to Earth'. Grab that one the moment it opens, then sweep the rest whenever you like.
Each meditation takes under a minute — follow the breathing prompt to the end (quitting early does not count it). Use a collectible map and tick them off region by region. Sources: PowerPyx (flags this trophy as potentially missable) and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide:
What to do — take Bret's hunting request and bag the unique animal he is after.
Where — Bret's strand, out in the hunting grounds.
When — anytime during or after the story, while his strand is active in your journal.
Track quietly: the animal spooks at full sprint and gunfire — walk, crouch, and use the spotlight at dawn for the cleanest shot.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide:
What to do — find every card in 3 of the Collectible Card sets.
Where — cards glow on inspection and sit in fixed spots city-wide.
When — anytime; permanent pickups.
Sets are themed by district, so sweep one district at a time with a map. Pick the three smallest sets first — the trophy needs 3 complete sets, not every card in the game.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide:
What to do — use the WAiNK It app at 100 different locations.
Where — anywhere the app allows a tag; it steers you to eligible spots.
When — anytime; the counter is account-wide and permanent.
Chain it with other travel: tag spots along your routes to races, meditation spots and card pickups and the counter fills without a dedicated tour. Sources: PowerPyx lists this among the big grinds.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide:
What to do — complete 50 challenges of any kind (the challenge log counts them).
Where — everywhere: time trials, target challenges, stunt and collectible challenges.
When — anytime; it accumulates across everything, Shooting Range drills included.
If you are doing The Shootist (42 golds) you are most of the way here already. PowerPyx's 100% checklist only demands 70 of 80 challenges, so 50 is comfortably reachable.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide:
What to do — get a 4-star wanted level, keep your partner with you, and successfully evade the police.
Where — Vice City streets with heat-generating crimes.
When — anytime both partners are active (not mission-locked away).
Community tip: raise 4 stars fast by attacking a heavily guarded operation, then use a pay-n-spray-style gap or an offshore escape with your partner in the vehicle. Do not let the partner die — the evasion only counts with both of you through to the end.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide:
What to do — rob three stores in a row while your wanted level stays alive the whole time.
Where — pick three convenience stores close together on a single strip.
When — anytime with the partner available.
Plan the route first: shop 1 triggers the stars, jog to shop 2, then 3, keeping cops in view but not cornering you. A fast car parked between shops makes the timing trivial.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide:
What to do — 'discover' 100 different vehicles (sit in or drive each unique model once).
Where — traffic, showrooms, boats, aircraft.
When — start immediately: it fills fastest during the story if you habitually carjack something new each leg of a drive.
Traffic alone covers most ground models; hit a marina and the airport for boats and planes to round out the list. (The game holds 277 vehicles, so 100 is well under half.)

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide:
What to do — kill 5 enemies during one activation of Combat Focus (the slow-mo ability).
Where — any firefight with 5+ enemies; gang illegal operations and late-story shootouts are densest.
When — anytime.
Charge the meter first with clean kills, then activate when the pack is clustered, headshot four quickly and finish the fifth before the meter drains. Robbing a busy illegal operation is the community-recommended farm.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.missable_note: Tied to the VCIA chapter — grab it during Hi-Jacked while the airfield is open; no mission replay means a missed window stays missed.
trophies.guide:
What to do — escape VCIA in an 'unscheduled' way: steal a plane or force a takeoff rather than boarding legitimately.
Where — the VCIA airfield.
When — MISSABLE: the airfield is only open to you during the VCIA chapter (Hi-Jacked's window). While there for the mission, break off to the runway, get airborne in anything with wings, and the trophy pops.
Sources: PSNProfiles flags this as chapter-locked; PowerPyx's no-mission-replay note is the reason to save beforehand.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.missable_note: Tied to the story window where a Rhino tank is available — the window closes with its chapter, so keep a save before it.
trophies.guide:
What to do — get inside and use a Rhino tank during the stretch of the story where one is available.
Where — the military presence tied to the relevant chapter.
When — MISSABLE: the Rhino window closes after its chapter.
The moment you first have one in reach, drive it and fire the cannon — the trophy pops on use. Sources: PowerPyx lists this as a one-window trophy.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide:
What to do — complete a jewelry store robbery with zero detections.
Where — jewelry stores in the city shopping districts.
When — anytime.
Casing matters: watch guard patrol loops from across the street, take the counter staff quietly, smash cases out of camera sight-lines, and leave before the alarm stage. Save before entering — one spotted moment resets the attempt.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide:
What to do — pull off 5 bank vault robberies, escaping each time.
Where — bank vault targets across Leonida (marked once cased).
When — anytime; the counter accumulates.
Escape is part of the trophy — do not count a heist until you have cleared the wanted level after the vault. Rotate between banks; each successful vault-plus-escape is one tick.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide:
What to do — stop an armored truck, take its cargo, and escape the heat.
Where — armored trucks run scheduled routes on main roads; tail one or intercept at a light.
When — anytime.
Classic method: block the lane, blow the rear doors, grab the cash, and lose the stars immediately — the escape must complete for the tick. Heavy traffic plus a fast getaway car does it.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide:
What to do — set foot in all 52 named areas of the map.
Where — the whole state, city to swamps to the keys.
When — anytime; the map shows which area names you have revealed.
Most fill themselves during the story; sweep the remainder by driving the coast road and the inland highways. Stepping into the boundary is enough — no lingering required.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide:
What to do — rob one illegal operation owned by each of the 9 gangs.
Where — illegal operation icons on the map, owner-labeled per gang.
When — anytime after they appear on the map.
Check the owner label before you hit one so you do not farm the same gang twice; one successful robbery per gang is all the trophy needs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide:
What to do — order and finish a cocktail at a bar with an ocean view on Ocean Beach.
Where — Ocean Beach beachfront bars.
When — anytime after free roam opens.
Walk in, sit at the view-side seating, order the cocktail and let the drink animation play out — leaving mid-drink cancels it.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide:
What to do — drive a car straight through a showroom's glass front.
Where — vehicle showrooms in the city.
When — anytime.
Walk in, get in the display model, and floor it through the windows onto the street. Have cash for the inevitable wanted level, or time it with a clean escape route.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide:
What to do — play and finish a game of bowling at the Kolt & Associates alley, completing your follow-through.
Where — the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
When — anytime.
A nod to a certain Liberty City cousin. Just bowl a full game — score does not matter, finishing the frames does.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.missable_note: A hidden trophy that fires at a specific story beat — play the story through once and it unlocks; keep a chapter save in case you want to be safe.
trophies.guide:
What to do — reach the story beat described only as 'a partnership with mass appeal' (a secret trophy; the community guides identify the scene).
Where — during the story.
When — MISSABLE-adjacent: it fires automatically at its story moment, so play the story through once and it is yours; a skipped cutscene still counts.
Sources: PSNProfiles' decode of the hidden trophy.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide:
What to do — make story and dialogue choices until the counter maxes (PSN data shows it tracks to 500 decisions).
Where — everywhere the game offers a choice prompt, in and out of missions.
When — it accumulates across the whole game; most players pass 500 naturally by the time the platinum grind is done.
If it stalls, grind choice-heavy stranger strands and activities — petty decisions count too. Sources: PSNProfiles (500-decision threshold).

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide:
What to do — fail something once, then succeed on the second attempt.
Where — any retryable activity or challenge.
When — anytime, and likely to pop by accident.
Deliberate route: start a simple arcade game or shooting-range drill, quit or fail the first run, then complete the second. The game tracks the fail-then-win pattern.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide:
What to do — witness one of the game's strange/paranormal Easter-egg events.
Where — community guides point to specific oddities around Leonida (the swamps and the keys draw the weird stuff).
When — anytime; the events recur.
Explore off the main roads at night and follow up any stranger strand that smells like a conspiracy — the strand finales count as the trigger.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide:
What to do — knock a pedestrian down using a melee attack from a moving vehicle (the melee drive-by).
Where — any street with slow foot traffic; do it away from police attention.
When — anytime.
Lean out and swing as you pass. Low speed works — the hit connects on contact, not force. One clean knockdown pops it.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide:
What to do — pass $250,000 of Marked Bills through your laundering contacts.
Where — contact drop-offs after robberies and operations.
When — anytime; the total accumulates.
Marked bills come primarily from vault and armored-truck work, so this fills alongside Maximum Withdrawal and A Classic Blitz Play. Laundering runs on a timer — keep feeding your contacts rather than hoarding, and it clears well before the platinum ends.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide:
What to do — spend $100,000 total in shops (cumulative across all stores).
Where — clothes, guns, food, vehicle accessories — any purchase counts.
When — anytime.
By the platinum's end you will have far more than $100k; buy wardrobe items and property upkeep as you go and this pops mid-grind without a dedicated shopping spree.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide:
What to do — buy all 8 garage properties.
Where — for-sale garage icons across the map.
When — once you have the cash (post-story earnings make this painless).
Each purchase is permanent and doubles as a convenient spawn point for the collectible sweeps, so buy them early in the grind phase if funds allow.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide:
What to do — register 10 different vehicles through the Scooter Bros app.
Where — anywhere you can sit in a vehicle and open the app.
When — anytime.
Sit in ten different cars (your garages make this trivial once Little Boxes is done), register each from the app menu — ten minutes, done.
